profiles.label: search-with-q-sofa
profiles.catalog_search_service: present in call graph; not top flat exclusive time

conclusion: Warm catalog search core (no q) ≈20ms Redis/validation-bound. Typical k6 search (non-empty q) adds large synchronous SearchQueryEvent INSERT on app()->terminating() — dominates SPX window. This disproves CatalogSearchService::facets as primary CPU consumer on warm cache; shifts hotspot to search analytics persistence for q-bearing traffic.
